liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Rattlesnake** (2 other sources): Song included Sleep Drifter teases, Honey quotes, and changed refrains to boogie [3][7]
- **Presumptuous** (1 review): Transition from Presumptuous to Hypertension is considered an early year-to-date candidate [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Satan Speeds Up**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [14]
- **Most of What I Like**: rare: 10 archived performances [14]
- **Late Set: Rattlesnake**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Presumptuous**: rare: 9 archived performances [14]
- **Slow Jam I**: rare: 4 archived performances [14]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Converge [14]

## The recordings

- **kglw2023-06-08.Burns.Schoeps.MK41.Flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 25 songs; 222 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the audio quality as top-shelf and the day as spectacular; Listener states all three recorded performances are top notch; Listener praises the recording quality and calls it a favorite live album [10][12][13]
- **kglw2023-06-08.mc930-late**: source not stated; 12 songs; 105 min [3]
- **kglw2023-06-08.M60.9624.EarlyShow**: source not stated; 13 songs; 115 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **kglw2023-06-08.mc930-early**: source not stated; 13 songs; 116 min [4]

## Around the show

- Opening band Kamikaze Palm Tree cancelled their set due to an inclement weather warning [3]
- Opening band Kamikaze Palm Tree cancelled their set due to an inclement weather warning [7]
- Song was dedicated to Cavs’ father, Bill, described as the best plumber in the world [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2023-06-08.Burns.Schoeps.MK41.Flac24**: taped by Joe Burns; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: Schoeps MK41's > Actives > BabyNBox > Roland r07 > 24/48 [1]
- **kglw2023-06-08.mc930-late**: taped by discocape; transferred by discocape; source: Beyerdynamic mc930 Cards [3]
- **kglw2023-06-08.M60.9624.EarlyShow**: taped by bonobeats; transferred by bonobeats; source: Telefunken M60 (omni, 50cm spacing @ 60 degrees DFC)>SD Mixpre6 (96/24) [2]
- **kglw2023-06-08.mc930-early**: taped by discocape; transferred by discocape; source: Beyerdynamic mc930 Cards [4]
- kglw2023-06-08.Burns.Schoeps.MK41.Flac24: Recorded with Schoeps MK41s into a Roland R07, tracked, and converted to FLAC [1]
- kglw2023-06-08.mc930-late: Recorded with Beyerdynamic mc 930s into a Zoom H8, tracked, and transferred by discocape [3]
